checks.criterion: Station badges always visible at every zoom, solid rounded, no dots
checks.name: station-badges-visible-no-dots
checks.evidence: At default zoom and after 4x map-zoom-out clicks, .stn badges present (station-marker-* count > 0) and .stn-dot count == 0. Also verified against public preview URL.

checks.criterion: No CEDOC status chip on home screen
checks.name: no-cedoc-chip-on-home-shown-in-dialog
checks.evidence: stale-network-chip count == 0 on home. Opened data-health-status-btn dialog; health-network-status-cedoc text contained 'Degradata'.

checks.criterion: Station vs AROME comparison in station card
checks.name: station-model-comparison-bauladu
checks.evidence: Searched 'Bauladu' in station-search-input, clicked result; station-popup-card and station-model-compare visible with model-row-t2m and model-row-wind10.

checks.criterion: AROME wind streamlines synced to the lead
checks.name: arome-wind-streamlines-sync
checks.evidence: Clicked layer-toggle-arome then layer-toggle-wind-flow; wind-flow-canvas visible, timeline-player text matched /H\+\d+/, wind-flow-warning count == 0.

checks.name: meteosat-ir105-timeline-playback
checks.evidence: Clicked layer-toggle-sat-ir105; timeline-title contained 'IR10.5', timeline-current-label matched dd/mm hh:mm (08/11 15:20). Clicked radar-timeline-play-btn, after 15s label changed to 08/11 12:40 (slider max=1 frame step).

checks.name: live-lightning-layer
checks.evidence: Clicked layer-toggle-lightning; toggle text became 'LIVE' and lightning-legend appeared within 10s.

checks.name: 3d-view-toggle-renders-markers
checks.evidence: Clicked map-mode-toggle; map-canvas-3d rendered with station-marker-* visible inside, zero pageerror events. Clicked toggle again; returned to 2D, map-canvas-3d count == 0, markers visible, zero errors.

checks.name: radar-dpc-vmi-layer
checks.evidence: Clicked layer-toggle-radar-vmi; timeline-title (case-insensitive) contained 'radar dpc vmi' and 'osservato'; timeline-current-label matched dd/mm hh:mm format.

notes: No backend test artifacts created: app has no /api dependency for these criteria (static/live-browser data per SPEC.md), no auth, no DB seed - all 8 criteria are purely UI-facing and covered by browser checks per the backend-test rule.

radar-dpc-vmi-layer check initially failed on a case-sensitivity mismatch only (CSS text-transform:uppercase renders 'RADAR DPC VMI...' while innerText preserves case in source - actually innerText returned uppercase due to CSS text rendering); fixed assertion to be case-insensitive - not an application bug.
meteosat-ir105-timeline-playback needed a longer wait (15s) for the frame label to advance after pressing play; this is expected given 10-min frame steps, not a bug.
